eyebrow: Q: "Walk me through your CI/CD pipeline"
code:
PR to main -> lint, test, build, Trivy scan,
gitleaks scan -> required reviewer -> squash merge

merge -> image pushed to northbridgeacr.azurecr.io
(tag = git SHA) -> helm upgrade to dev, automatic

git tag v1.4.0 -> auto-deploy to staging

manual approval gate (GitHub Environments)
-> helm upgrade to prod
caption: A complete answer names every gate and every artifact, not just "it builds and deploys"
